meta_description:
2,989 likes, 301 comments - muradosmann on September 20, 2026: "Georgia has always had a special place in our #FollowMeTo story. We first came here years ago to capture its people, landscapes and unique spirit.

This week, I returned to Tbilisi for the launch of Trump Tower Tbilisi — a 62-storey landmark set to become the tallest building in Georgia and the new global address in the heart of Tbilisi.

It was exciting to see how the city continues to grow while preserving the energy and character that have always made it so special.

#TrumpTowerTbilisi".
